private.en: Only your signed-in account can read these entries. Keep quotes, observations and unverified ideas distinct.
private.zh: 僅登入本人可讀取。依日期保存 MD，保留原話、觀察與未證實事項的區別。

reminder.en: Your diary review is due. Generate Markdown in the original mobile chat, then import it here.
reminder.zh: 本期整理已到期。請到手機原對話產生 MD，再回來匯入。

review.en: Review the date and content before importing. Each file becomes one entry; event dates are never inferred.
review.zh: 請確認日期與內容後匯入；每份 MD 保存為一篇日記，不會自動推測事件日期。

storyHint.en: The listed events in time order. Select a passage for the full record.
storyHint.zh: 依時間順序串起清單裡的事件，點任一段可看完整紀錄。

levelsDesc.zh: 角色等級一覽與角色牆

teamSkillsChart.en: Bubble size is each category's total proficiency score; click a bubble to open its skills.
teamSkillsChart.zh: 泡泡大小是各類別技能的熟練度總分；點一個泡泡可展開該類別的技能。

teamIntro.en: Built and maintained by Tianyi Kao, bringing experience in financial research, enterprise software and cloud deployment to data organization and decision tools.
teamIntro.zh: 由 Tianyi Kao 開發與維護，結合金融資料研究、企業系統開發與雲端部署經驗，持續改善資料整理與決策工具。

teamProfile.en: Meet the maintainer and explore the full background ↗
teamProfile.zh: 認識維護者與完整經歷 ↗

teamMarketBody.en: Experience in banking fintech products and macro research at an investment advisory firm, working with market data, automated reports and Power BI dashboards to support decisions.
teamMarketBody.zh: 曾參與銀行金融科技產品與投顧總經研究，處理市場資料、自動化報表及 Power BI 儀表板，理解資料如何成為判斷依據。

teamSystemsBody.en: Experience with financial sector document management, authentication, API integration and knowledge retrieval, covering data workflows, versioning and frontend/backend integration.
teamSystemsBody.zh: 具備金融業文件管理、登入權限、API 串接與知識檢索系統經驗，涵蓋資料流程、版本管理及前後端整合。

teamOperationsBody.en: Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containers, cloud provisioning, tests and monitoring, applied to product updates and issue tracking.
teamOperationsBody.zh: 具備 CI/CD、容器化、雲端佈建、測試與監控實作經驗，將工程背景用於產品更新與問題追蹤。

teamSkills.zh: 查看完整技術能力與工具

operationsTitle.zh: 產品運作資訊 · AI 使用紀錄

contactEyebrow.zh: 聯繫 · 試用 · 合作

contactTitle.en: Turn your research process into decisions you can see
contactTitle.zh: 把你的研究流程，變成看得見的決策

contactBody.en: Trials, data integration and feature requests are all discussed by email. Pick a topic and the email comes with the questions to answer.
contactBody.zh: 試用、資料整合與功能需求都直接以 email 討論。選一個主題，信件會帶好要回答的問題。

body.en: Tell us how you research today and which markets you follow.
body.zh: 說明你目前的研究方式與關注的市場。

body.en: Bring broker statements, spreadsheets or reports into the charts.
body.zh: 把券商對帳單、試算表或報告接進圖表。

body.en: Describe the problem and what a good result looks like.
body.zh: 描述想解決的問題與理想的結果。

heroTitle.en: From today, hire a top-tier institutional researcher
heroTitle.zh: 從今天起，雇用一位頂級機構研究員

heroTagline.en: I was a researcher on a hedge fund trading desk. This puts that process to work for you: every day it reads the reports and the data, then writes down the call, the reasons and what would flip it. You make the decision.
heroTagline.zh: 我在避險基金交易室做過研究員。這裡把那套做法交給你：每天讀完報告與資料，寫下判斷、理由與翻轉條件，你只負責決策。

productBrand.zh: TY 市場研究室 · TY Multiverse

productAudience.en: For individual investors who want an institutional research process without hiring a research team, and without writing code.
productAudience.zh: 給想要機構等級的研究流程、卻沒有研究團隊的個人投資人；不用寫程式。

productWorkflow.en: Keep the evidence behind each research decision
productWorkflow.zh: 從市場研究到決策，留下每一步的依據

productCollectBody.en: Read macro indicators, Taiwan market positioning, financial statements and industry research together. Compare sources and dates to understand the reasoning behind others’ market views.
productCollectBody.zh: 集中閱讀總經指標、台股籌碼、財報與產業研究，對照來源與資料日期，理解他人判斷市場的理由。

productJudgeBody.en: Record observations, reasons and the conditions that would change your view. Revisit your assumptions as the data changes.
productJudgeBody.zh: 把觀察、理由與改變看法的條件整理成研究紀錄；資料更新時，回頭檢查自己的假設。

productDecideBody.en: Compare signals with trend charts, supply chain maps and technology roadmaps. Build your own quantitative research and investment decision process step by step.
productDecideBody.zh: 用趨勢圖、供應鏈圖與技術路線圖交叉比較訊號，逐步建立自己的量化研究與投資決策流程。

productFaqTitle.en: Can I start quantitative research without coding?
productFaqTitle.zh: 不會寫程式，也能開始量化研究嗎？

productFaqBody.en: Start with sourced data, written decision conditions and chart comparisons. This page demonstrates market data and research tools. To bring your own workflow here, email us about your needs and how you work today.
productFaqBody.zh: 可以先從整理有來源的資料、記錄判斷條件，以及比較圖表開始。本頁展示市場資料與研究工具；如果想把自己的研究流程搬進來，請以 email 說明需求與目前的做法。

productPricingBody.en: The aim is to let you use research tools as needed without an expensive fixed subscription. Pricing and access details have not been announced. Please email for access, data integration or service enquiries.
productPricingBody.zh: 希望讓不想負擔高額固定訂閱的人，也能依研究需求使用。價格與開放方式尚未公布；試用、資料整合與服務洽詢，一律以 email 聯繫。

marketAutomaticHoldings.zh: 全部持倉 · 依部位由大到小

macroTitle.en: Key macro data · U.S., Taiwan and more
macroTitle.zh: 多國重要總體經濟資料

macroDescription.en: Labor, inflation, rates, consumption, trade and FX for the U.S., Taiwan and other major economies, with upcoming release reminders.
macroDescription.zh: 美國、台灣與主要經濟體的就業、通膨、利率、消費、匯率與貿易資料，並提醒即將公布的日程。

macroLoading.zh: 正在載入總體經濟資料…

macroNotConfigured.en: Macro data collection is not enabled yet.
macroNotConfigured.zh: 總體經濟資料收集尚未啟用。

macroNoEvents.en: No upcoming macro releases in the calendar.
macroNoEvents.zh: 目前沒有即將公布的總體經濟事件。

macroCoreCpiMonthly.zh: 美國核心 CPI 月增率

macroCoreCpiAnnual.zh: 美國核心 CPI 年增率

macroTreasuryYield10.zh: 美國 10 年期公債殖利率

marketEventsDescription.en: Official revenue and financial report releases, plus upcoming investor conferences.
marketEventsDescription.zh: 月營收與財報實際公告日，以及近期法說會。

marketEventsEmpty.en: No recent releases or upcoming conferences for selected targets.
marketEventsEmpty.zh: 目前持股沒有近期公告或即將舉行的法說會。

marketEventsUnavailable.zh: 事件資料暫時無法取得。

marketTargetsDescription.en: Broker target prices over time: dots are each broker's target, the dashed line and band are the consensus mean and high/low.
marketTargetsDescription.zh: 券商目標價時間軸：圓點是各券商目標價，虛線與色帶是共識均值與最高／最低。

marketResearchQualityGuide.zh: 研究品質準則與 AI 更新提示

marketAiInstructions.en: AI agents: read the current analysis and this instrument's data, then update the existing commentary. Identify your AI/model, explain changes and risks, and save. Confirm the saved revision below. Do not claim data you could not verify.
marketAiInstructions.zh: 給 AI：先閱讀目前評論與本標的資料，再更新同一份分析。填寫 AI／模型名稱，說明看法、變化與風險後儲存，並確認下方已儲存的版本。未能驗證的資料請明確標示。

marketAiComment.zh: 目前評論 · 直接修改後更新

marketAiLogin.en: Sign in to save. Your commentary and AI/model name will be publicly visible.
marketAiLogin.zh: 登入後可儲存。評論與 AI／模型名稱會公開顯示。

marketAiHistory.zh: 歷次版本 · 最近 20 筆

marketAiApiHelp.en: GET this endpoint first. PUT JSON with model, content and expectedRevision using your signed-in Bearer token. Use revision 0 for the first analysis. On 409 reload and reconcile your draft. Never put a token in the URL.
marketAiApiHelp.zh: 先 GET 此端點，再以登入的 Bearer token PUT JSON：model、content、expectedRevision。首次使用版本 0；遇到 409 請重新讀取並整合草稿。Token 不可放入網址。

marketAiEmpty.en: No saved analysis yet. Write the first commentary above.
marketAiEmpty.zh: 尚無已儲存分析，可在上方填寫第一份評論。

marketAiLoadError.en: Analysis could not be loaded. Reload before editing.
marketAiLoadError.zh: 無法載入分析，請重新載入後再編輯。

marketAiSaveError.en: Save failed. Your draft remains in the editor; try again.
marketAiSaveError.zh: 儲存失敗，草稿仍保留在編輯區，請稍後重試。

marketAiConflict.en: Another AI updated this analysis. Copy your draft, reload the saved version, reconcile the changes, then save again.
marketAiConflict.zh: 另一個 AI 已更新分析。請先複製草稿，重新載入已儲存版本、整合變更後再儲存。

marketAiSignIn.en: Sign in before saving. Your draft is preserved.
marketAiSignIn.zh: 請先登入再儲存，草稿已保留。

marketFundamentalsRevenue.zh: 月營收成長率 · 年增 / 月增

marketFundamentalsNoCompany.en: Company fundamentals are not available for index futures.
marketFundamentalsNoCompany.zh: 指數期貨沒有公司基本面資料。

marketFundamentalsNoRevenue.en: Monthly revenue is unavailable from the current official feed.
marketFundamentalsNoRevenue.zh: 目前官方來源沒有可用的月營收資料。

marketFundamentalsNoStatements.en: Quarterly statements are not available for this company in the current public feed.
marketFundamentalsNoStatements.zh: 目前公開來源沒有這家公司的季財報資料。

marketFundamentalsNoRecords.en: No stored records are available for this statement.
marketFundamentalsNoRecords.zh: 目前沒有已保存的這類財報資料。

marketFundamentalsNoPriorQuarter.en: Preceding quarter is unavailable; values remain cumulative.
marketFundamentalsNoPriorQuarter.zh: 前一季資料缺少，保留累計申報值。

marketFundamentalsRefreshFailed.zh: 更新失敗，顯示快取資料

marketFundamentalsHistoryPending.zh: 歷史資料蒐集中，稍後自動更新

marketFundamentalsCashConversion.zh: 營業現金流 ÷ 稅前淨利

marketFundamentalsCapexToOcf.zh: 資本支出 ÷ 營業現金流

marketFundamentalsCashFlowNote.en: Cash flow statements are year-to-date, so changes compare with the same period last year.
marketFundamentalsCashFlowNote.zh: 現金流量表為年初至今累計，故只與去年同期比較。

marketFundamentalsRatioNote.en: pp = percentage-point change in the margin. Growth rates are blank when the base period is zero or negative.
marketFundamentalsRatioNote.zh: pp = 比率增減的百分點。基期為零或負值時不計算成長率。

marketFundamentalsDerivedQuarter.en: Single quarter derived from official cumulative values; EPS stays as reported.
marketFundamentalsDerivedQuarter.zh: 單季金額由官方累計值相減推導；EPS 保留原始申報值。

marketHistorySelectStock.en: Select a stock to load daily history.
marketHistorySelectStock.zh: 選擇股票以載入每日歷史資料。

marketHistoryInstitutionalDescription.en: Foreign and investment trust net trading · shares · hover bars for date and values
marketHistoryInstitutionalDescription.zh: 外資與投信買賣超 · 股數 · 移到柱狀查看日期與數值

marketHistoryMarginDescription.en: Hover charts for daily figures. Margin and short balances use lots; borrowed stock sold uses shares. Sells (margin sell, short sell, borrowed stock sold) are plotted below zero.
marketHistoryMarginDescription.zh: 移到圖表查看每日數值。融資融券餘額以張計，借券賣出以股計。賣出類（融資賣出、融券賣出、借券賣出）以負數軸顯示於零線下方。

marketHistoryOwnershipDescription.en: TDCC weekly distribution · all tiers in four groups (sums to 100%)
marketHistoryOwnershipDescription.zh: 集保週持股分布 · 全部級距分四組（合計 100%）

marketHistoryOwnershipHoverGuide.en: Hover each chart for its date and value.
marketHistoryOwnershipHoverGuide.zh: 移到各圖表查看日期與數值。

marketHistoryTierPercentAxis.zh: 持股級距 · 已發行股數比例 (%)

marketHistoryCollecting.en: Collecting history for this stock; the charts fill in automatically.
marketHistoryCollecting.zh: 這檔股票的歷史資料蒐集中，圖表會自動補上。

marketCustomSubtitle.en: Up to five stocks or futures, shown under the holdings.
marketCustomSubtitle.zh: 最多 5 檔股票或期貨，顯示在持股下方。

marketCustomSearchPlaceholder.en: Code or name, e.g. 2330 or TSMC
marketCustomSearchPlaceholder.zh: 代號或名稱，例如 2330 或 台積電

marketHistoryNoSpotTicker.en: No spot ticker is available for this futures contract; chart history is unavailable.
marketHistoryNoSpotTicker.zh: 此期貨合約沒有對應的現貨代號，因此無法顯示圖表歷史資料。

marketHistoryTaifexAggregateDescription.en: TAIFEX participant totals for the futures product category; not contract-specific positions.
marketHistoryTaifexAggregateDescription.zh: TAIFEX 期貨商品類別法人彙總，並非個別契約部位。

marketHistorySpotDataUnavailable.en: This panel requires an underlying stock ticker and is unavailable for index futures.
marketHistorySpotDataUnavailable.zh: 此面板需要對應現貨股票代號，指數期貨無此資料。

marketHistoryOpenInterestTitle.zh: 三大法人未平倉淨額（口）

marketHistorySpotInstitutionalDescriptio.en: spot ticker foreign and investment trust net trading · shares · hover bars for date and values
marketHistorySpotInstitutionalDescriptio.zh: 現貨代號外資與投信買賣超 · 股數 · 移到柱狀查看日期與數值

marketHistoryNoStored.en: No stored history yet; first collection may take a few minutes.
marketHistoryNoStored.zh: 尚無已存歷史；首次回補可能需要幾分鐘。

marketHistoryUnavailable.zh: 歷史資料暫時無法取得。

marketHistoryNoRows.en: No historical rows are available yet.

marketHistoryChartGuide.en: Move over a candle for daily OHLC. Click to pin a date; drag to compare closing prices.
marketHistoryChartGuide.zh: 移到 K 棒查看當日 OHLC；點一下固定日期，按住拖曳可比較起訖收盤價。

portfolioHistoryDescription.en: Taiwan estimated total assets · daily closing snapshot
portfolioHistoryDescription.zh: 台灣預估總資產 · 每日最後一筆估值

researchEconomicsSignIn.en: Research cost estimates and percentage-only portfolio returns are available without signing in.
researchEconomicsSignIn.zh: 免登入查看研究費用估算與僅以百分比呈現的投資組合報酬。

portfolioReturnTitle.zh: 自最早快照起的投資組合報酬率

portfolioReturnDescription.en: Return is rebased to 0% on the earliest recorded portfolio value. Account values are never shown.
portfolioReturnDescription.zh: 以最早一筆正資產快照設為 0%，計算累積報酬率；不顯示帳戶資產金額。

researchTokenCostPending.en: Dashed amber line and right axis: cumulative token cost of the scheduled research routines in USD (estimated). The line appears once the routines start reporting usage.
researchTokenCostPending.zh: 虛線與右側座標為排程研究（雲端 routine）的累積 token 費用（美元估算）；排程開始回報用量後才會出現這條線。

leverageFormulaCombined.en:
Taiwan: (futures exposure + stock value + cash) ÷ Taiwan assets
Overseas: gross position value ÷ net liquidation
Combined: (TW position exposure + overseas positions) ÷ combined assets
leverageFormulaCombined.zh:
台灣：（期貨曝險＋股票市值＋現金）÷ 台灣總資產
海外：海外總持倉市值 ÷ 海外淨清算價值
合併：（台灣持倉曝險＋海外持倉市值）÷ 合併總資產

leverageFormulaTaiwan.en: Taiwan: (futures exposure + stock value + cash) ÷ Taiwan assets
leverageFormulaTaiwan.zh: 台灣：（期貨曝險＋股票市值＋現金）÷ 台灣總資產

adminOnlyContact.en: This feature is available to administrators. Please contact an administrator.
adminOnlyContact.zh: 此功能僅供管理員使用，請聯繫管理員。

recentNotes.zh: 工具背後的工程實作與技術整理

title.zh: 工程知識庫與開發紀錄

tagline.en: Document problems, architecture choices and validation results to inform the next decision.
tagline.zh: 記錄問題、架構選擇與驗證結果，讓每次開發都成為下一次決策的依據。

empty.en: No matching articles. Adjust the keyword or category.
empty.zh: 沒有符合條件的文章，請調整關鍵字或分類。

unavailable.en: The article service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
unavailable.zh: 文章服務暫時無法使用，請稍後再試。

methodBody.en: Development logs retain context, decisions, implementation and validation limits. Browse fundamentals by technology and deliveries by date.
methodBody.zh: 每篇開發紀錄保留背景、決策、實作與驗證限制；基礎筆記依技術分類查找，實際交付則按時間追蹤。
